dimensions.description: How a numeric metric is rendered.

values.bare: Numeric value only, no visual encoding. In this app: the 'values' signals display.
values.trended: Numeric value with an inline sparkline beside it. Not yet offered by this app.
values.charted: A chart replaces the numeric value as the primary representation. In this app: the 'graph' signals display.

dimensions.description: Whether a collapsible region starts open.

values.collapsed: Region starts closed; user opens what they want. In this app: summary contract cards.
values.expanded: Region starts open; user closes what they don't want. In this app: extended staffing/scope detail.
values.selective: Some subset starts open, chosen by a rule over the data. In this app: e.g. keep-top-two by Margin, expand-one by Profit.

dimensions.description: The predicate that explains which items a user chooses to inspect, when they inspect only some.
dimensions.values: open — the agent describes the rule in prose, e.g. 'the two highest-margin contracts'

dimensions.description: Which metrics the user actually acts on, versus which are merely present.
dimensions.values: open — the agent names metrics in priority order, e.g. 'Margin, then Win prob.'
